string.ID: all four limbs of mine do long to run
weary mind cannot conceive of fun
I can feel my walls are closing in
Hindriarch says all I do is sin
evil thoughts accost my blackened soul

strings.string: 邪念缠上我漆黑的魂灵

string.ID: splitting head feels much more like a hole

strings.string: 裂开的头颅更像一口井

string.ID: spitting anger boils up in my blood
hardened heart despises all of Qud

strings.string: 硬化的心厌弃卡德（Qud）众生

string.ID: my mind does all grievances rehash
Hindriarch treats kendren like they're trash
this cruel world does bring me sad and low
there's a line I clearly cannot tow
your sparring axeblade parts the air
you run your fingers through your hair
you look at me with those sweet eyes
you're close enough to tantalize
you stand, resplendent and refined
I think perhaps you could be mine

strings.string: 我想也许你能归我名下

string.ID: your armor glints under the sun

strings.string: 你的甲胄在日光下闪亮

string.ID: our hearts both beat in time as one
you take my hand, yours rough but warm

strings.string: 你握住我的手，粗粝而温热

string.ID: my eyes, unbidden, trace your form
my heart ascends the spindle's height

strings.string: 我的心飞上纺锤（the Spindle）之巅

string.ID: I know that everything's all right
a happy smile comes to my face

strings.string: 一抹笑意浮上我的面庞

string.ID: I think that I might find my place

strings.string: 我想我或许能寻到地方

string.ID: I feel the gentle warmth of love

strings.string: 我感到爱意温柔地发烫

string.ID: I hope that we could be enough
I feel a tingle on my skin

strings.string: 我感到皮肤上一阵战栗

string.ID: my heart scarce knows where to begin
my breath comes, like my heart, too quick

strings.string: 我的呼吸与心跳一样急

string.ID: I see you and become lovesick
tended fields of lah
felling trees by saw
eating in a yurt
farming 'til we hurt
stripping watervine
claiming to be fine
putting safety first
planning for the worst
gath'ring morning dew
fearing what is new
ease us when we hurt
to the past revert
treat us like their own
melt their hearts of stone
let me be myself
look out for our health
see that life needs love
ever be enough
offer me your hand
ever understand
However can I tell my aching heart

strings.string: 我该如何告诉我这疼痛的心

string.ID: that our remaining years will be apart?

strings.string: 我们余下的年月竟要离分？

string.ID: Although I may succumb to nature's fang,

strings.string: 纵然我或将屈服于自然的獠牙，

string.ID: my heart needs more than one square parasang.

strings.string: 我的心要的却超过一平方帕拉桑（parasang）。

string.ID: But I must leave you if you won't concede

strings.string: 但我必须离开，若你不肯让步

string.ID: that death will find me should I stay unfreed.

strings.string: 我若不得自由，死亡终会寻来。

string.ID: Now knowing I must go and you must stay

strings.string: 如今我知我必须走，你必须留

string.ID: it makes my tender heartstrings start to fray.

strings.string: 我柔软的心弦已开始颤抖。

string.ID: To know I cannot stay, and you can't leave

strings.string: 明知我留不下，而你也走不掉
